entities.name: Query Rpo1N homolog
observations: 768 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 86.48 kDa and pI 8.84.
Pfam matches RNA_pol_Rpb1_1 (PF04997; residues 22–357), RNA_pol_Rpb1_2 (PF00623; residues 359–525), and RNA_pol_Rpb1_3 (PF04983; residues 528–704).
Homology supports an archaeal DNA-directed RNA polymerase largest-subunit/Rpo1N-like protein, but exact organism and substrate specificity are not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: DNA-dependent RNA polymerization
observations: RNA(n) + a ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate → RNA(n+1) + diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.6; Rhea RHEA:21248/RHEA:14527/RHEA:17342.

The reaction is catalyzed by the multisubunit DNA-dependent RNA polymerase complex; the query protein is inferred to be a catalytic/structural largest-subunit component rather than a stand-alone enzyme.

entities.name: Thermococcus celer Rpo1N
observations: Reviewed UniProt P31813 is a close homolog with 36.8% identity, 96.9% query coverage, and E-value 6.09e-141.
Annotated as DNA-dependent RNA polymerase subunit Rpo1N, forming the clamp head domain; associated with Mg2+ and Zn2+ binding and the RNA polymerase complex.

entities.name: Saccharolobus solfataricus Rpo1N
observations: Reviewed UniProt Q980R2 is a close homolog with 35.9% identity, 96.7% query coverage, and E-value 3.74e-139.
Annotated as DNA-dependent RNA polymerase subunit Rpo1N, part of the archaeal RNA polymerase complex, with Mg2+ and Zn2+ binding annotations.

entities.name: Saccharolobus shibatae Rpo1N
observations: Reviewed UniProt B8YB53 is a close homolog with 35.7% identity, 96.7% query coverage, and E-value 1.46e-138.
Annotated as DNA-dependent RNA polymerase subunit Rpo1N, part of a 13-subunit archaeal RNA polymerase complex, with Mg2+ and Zn2+ binding annotations.
